misconceptionTests: Chemical purity or large batches do not establish stronger/risk-free human effects.
An unchanged recipe and geometrically larger vessel do not guarantee same thermal conditions or quality.
Chemical transformation differs from separation, testing and initially physical formulation.
A positive contribution is not total profit; preference is not a representative market or actual purchase.
An immediate valid result does not justify all future batches/permanent stability.
An impurity or longer water contact is not a uniquely established causal mechanism.
